title: Atmospheric directive
description: Runtime output of the Almanac evaluator. The complete atmospheric scene description the runtime consumes. Layered atop the TOD base envelope (Stage's per-Look design.json), under per-Look visual-styling overrides.

clouds.description: Active cloud preset blend. Cap of 3 keeps the shader bounded. Two is the common case during weather transitions; one is steady state.

scale.description: Cloud-advection multiplier on Atmosphere; preserved for Phase 5a + 9b. Not used by wind-field.js.

dir.description: Compass bearing the wind is blowing TO (rendering convention; flipped from meteorological).

speed.description: Resolved wind speed in m/s. Brief 9a — read by `src/lib/wind-field.js#windAt` to drive tree sway + (Brief 9b) Atmosphere cloud advection.

gustsScale.description: Peak amplitude (m/s) of smoothmax-modulated gust spikes. Phase 6 modulators author this (cold-front passage, derecho, etc.).

gustEnvelope.description: Slow (~30s) modulation on gust-spike amplitude. 0 = calm spike floor, 1 = full spike amplitude. Phase 6 modulators author this.

gustFrontVelocity.description: World-space gust-front advection velocity (m/s). Independent of base wind per ADR S2 — outflow boundaries can outrun ambient wind. If absent, wind-field.js defaults to baseDirection × 10 m/s.
